capabilities: Rank search results by match quality, exact titles and headings first
Match plurals, camelCase, typos, partial words, and frontmatter aliases
Open results at the matching line with the words selected
List recently opened notes when the search box is empty
extras: The README states it works entirely offline, building its index in memory with no network access; it also explains how to replace the core search hotkey.
intentEvidence: To use it in place of the built-in search, give it Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+F
problem: Obsidian's built-in search returns unranked results, so a note titled exactly like the query can rank below notes that merely mention the words.
summary: Ranked vault search that orders results by match quality: exact titles first, then headings, then line contents, with fuzzy matching.
